character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A small, wiry green-skinned goblin raider, short and hunched, long pointed ears, big toothy grin, brass goggles pushed up on its forehead, a topknot of dark hair. Patched brown leather vest and wraps, a torn strip of deep blue academy cloth with a small gold star tied round its waist as a trophy, bare clawed feet. Holds a jagged steel knife in its right hand, crouched low and ready to run. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather, brass, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
